CommunityApplications.Profile:
benjaminmue's apps for Unraid.

Obsidian Sync Station keeps an Obsidian vault synced on your server using Obsidian's official headless Sync client, with a LAN-only web UI, local and off-site (restic) backups, one-click restore and ntfy notifications.

Unraid Themer is a non-destructive theming plugin for the Unraid 7 webGUI: pick a bundled theme or build your own from 8 colors, browse a built-in theme store, swap the UI icons for open-source icon sets, and set a custom background image and logo. Currently in beta, testing and contributing are welcome.

Source and issues: https://github.com/benjaminmue
